ICSE 2027 (Synthetic Fixture) Paper #9 SchemaShift: Safe Database Migrations in Continuous Deployment
===========================================================================

Review #9A [r2]
===========================================================================

Overall merit
-------------
2. Weak reject

Reviewer expertise
------------------
Y. I am knowledgeable in this area.

Paper summary
-------------
In today's fast-paced world of continuous deployment, database migrations have become a critical bottleneck. This paper introduces SchemaShift, a novel tool that checks migrations before they reach producton.

Strengths
---------
SchemaShift is not just a checker. It is a safety net for the entire deployment pipeline. The evaluation is comprehensive, rigorous, and insightful.

Detailed comments for authors
-----------------------------
The evaluation uses only 30 migrations, which is a significant limitation. As mentioned above, the tool is a safety net for deployments, and it is important to note that the resuls on larger schemas remain unclear.
